character.description: The same young adult male anime protagonist: silver-grey hair in a cropped, feathered cut, silver-grey eyes, a gentle face with focused eyes; an independent explorer of remote waters and wild places, wearing a weather-ready expedition coat, layered travel clothes, and practical boots with mirror blue accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in still lake mirroring mountains, stepping stones into the reflection, island tree and its double; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with mirror blue, dawn pink, forest green, silver; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by perfectly symmetrical wide shot split by the waterline, slow descent toward the reflected sky, close-up of a ripple spreading; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
